ADJOURNED SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
MONDAY - APRIL 13, 2026 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at cerritos.gov and at the Office of the City Clerk, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 1st floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the legislative body after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection in the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to city_clerk@cerritos.gov or by phone at (562) 916-1248 during regular business hours.
Order of Agenda
The City Council, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at cerritos.gov, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or in writing as described below.
In-person public comment : Public comment will be opened and may be provided during Agenda Item No. 5.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to city_clerk@cerritos.gov or by hard copy to the Office of the City Clerk at 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703 no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the legislative body prior to the meeting and retained with the official meeting record.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact City of Cerritos ADA/504 Coordinator, Drew Schneider, at (562) 916-1314 at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled meeting. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.
With the exception of Item 5, all agenda items will be held concurrently with the Monday, April 13, 2026, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting agenda.

This section is reserved for public comment on the Wednesday, April 8, 2026 Mayoral Transition. MINUTES OF AN ADJOURNED SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD
MONDAY, APRIL 13, 2026, 7:00 PM, IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBER AT CERRITOS CITY
HALL, 18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA.

With the exception of Item 5, all agenda items were held concurrently with the Thursday,
April 13, 2026, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting agenda.

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Pastor Rob Golding, First Christian Reformed Church
  of Artesia.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Cerritos Aquatic Club.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Jennifer Hong
  Council/Agency Member Sophia M. Tse
  Council/Agency Member Frank Aurelio Yokoyama
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Mark E. Pulido
  Mayor/Chair Lynda P. Johnson

5.  Public Comments on the Mayoral Transition (Wednesday, April 8, 2026
  Special Meeting Agenda Item 7)

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  David Pylman expressed concern regarding the continued public comment period for
  the Wednesday, April 8, 2026, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency Special
  Meeting (Mayoral Transition) to a date certain: the Monday, April 13, 2026, 7:00
  p.m. City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting.

  Seeing no further speakers, the Mayor declared the public comments period closed.

6.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 11:58 p.m.

  /s/Cynthia Nava______________________
